style.label: Theme
style.intro: Three skins (mint, peach, thread), each with a night and a day face, plus high contrast. Night comes first.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Pill-shaped actions; one primary per screen, in `accent`.

components.name: Secret
components.summary: A hidden mode that shows itself in stages, so a reader who misses it is guided to it instead of locked out.

components.name: Tool
components.summary: Small outlined pills for chrome: the ribbon's Lens, Day and Archive, the HUD's sound toggle, close buttons.

components.name: ChapterMarker
components.summary: The numbered eyebrow and display title that open every chapter.

components.name: Door
components.summary: A portal drawn into the world: an arch that glows its destination's color and swings ajar on hover.

components.name: Eye
components.summary: The wink: one eye shared across the worlds.

components.name: Field
components.summary: A lattice of cells that each hold their state at zero power, the e-paper idea as a canvas, with Conway's Life built in.

components.name: Guardian
components.summary: A small companion that follows the hand, watches with one eye, says one dry line when pressed, and can be thrown at things.

components.name: Hotspot
components.summary: A real button laid over something drawn in the art, so the picture itself is the interface (spores in the haze, an eye on a ridge, doors at the end).

components.name: PopUp
components.summary: A spread whose pieces stand up as the book opens: chapters that unfold instead of scroll.

components.name: Scene
components.summary: A beat: one screen of the story, at least `scene-beat` (100svh) tall, its words riding over the world.

components.name: SceneCaption
components.summary: A blurred `scrim` card that carries words over live media, the world canvas or video.

components.name: Stack
components.summary: An exploded cross-section: the layers of a thing, skin out, lying in 3D, with a legend that pulls focus to one layer.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: Reality status, told by shape first and color never alone.

components.name: Fold
components.summary: Paper that opens in panels, for something the reader chose to open: a letter, the long version, the receipts.

components.name: Footer
components.summary: The closing band: the mark, one statement that closes the loop, a short colophon and jump links back into the story.

components.name: Letter
components.summary: Depthfield in an inbox: an email built from tables and inline styles that says what a page would say.

components.name: Readout
components.summary: Labelled values in mono: a ledger strip for facts a reader may want to copy.

components.name: Station
components.summary: A numbered step in a long explanation: the numeral, the step (eyebrow + display title + paragraphs) and an aside of owners and notes.

components.name: Stretch
components.summary: Display type with a width axis that moves for a reason: Anybody, from condensed to wide, bound to a value the page actually has.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Categorical labels: owners, worlds, kinds.

components.name: Taste
components.summary: A lint for pages: `Depthfield.taste()` reads the rendered page for the tells that make it look generated and returns findings, each with the rule, a sample and a fix.

components.name: VersionCard
components.summary: A version in the archive: its art with the numeral over it, the name and date, one line, and how to open it.

components.name: WorldCard
components.summary: A list row that opens a world: a 64px tile (art or an icon on `surface`), the world's name in italic display, one line under it.

components.name: Cloth
components.summary: A woven cloth on a canvas: warp threads you can pluck, a weft you can pull, hung on a loom (`hang`) or laid down as land under the weather (`lay`).

components.name: Lamp
components.summary: One warm light that follows the hand, and a room light that dims everything reflective while cues that make their own light stay bright.

components.name: Weather
components.summary: Four weathers that follow the music, or the scroll: peach fall, red rain, mint clearing, night garden.

components.name: WorldCanvas
components.summary: The world behind the words: one full-bleed canvas of sky, a pointer-led sun, light shafts, three ridges with haze, particles that part around you, ripples where you press, and a vignette.

components.name: CursorRing
components.summary: A ring that follows a mouse pointer and grows over things you can press: a quiet cue that the art is interactive.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: A continuous setting: tilt sensitivity, warmth, volume.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: An on/off switch for settings panels: motion, sound, captions, the reality lens.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A centred modal for one decision: permission to use motion or the microphone, leaving a guided tour, resetting progress.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: A side panel over a veil: the archive of versions, a chapter index, settings.

components.name: FoundCard
components.summary: The discovery toast: a kicker with the running count, the find's name, a one-line definition and one true fact.

components.name: Loader
components.summary: The entry veil while the world warms up: the site's name, a thin progress line, a percentage, and a way past it.

components.name: Guide
components.summary: The "find N" pattern as an API: a count, one hint at a time for the next thing not yet found, and memory between visits.

components.name: HudChip
components.summary: A small HUD readout opposite the progress pill: a count of finds, the weather's name, a mode.

components.name: LensBanner
components.summary: The reality lens: a mode that lets the machinery show through.

components.name: ReelHud
components.summary: The guided tour's bar: shot number, shot name, a tuning or caption line, overall progress and a stop button, with letterbox bars sliding in.

components.name: Ribbon
components.summary: The version thread across the top: the mark, one knot per version on a hairline thread, and the page's tools.

components.name: ScrollProgress
components.summary: The floating HUD pill that tells the reader where they are in the story.

components.name: Sense
components.summary: A state inferred from how the pointer moves (arriving, calm, curious, caffeinated, still), shown in a HudChip that says it is inferred.

components.name: TiltChip
components.summary: The bubble level in the top bar: the phone's tilt, live.
